rules: Correlated latent traits are used; dimensions are not independent dice rolls.
Country culture changes means only weakly. Within-country standard deviation must exceed between-country mean differences on most traits.
Household stress, debt, dependents, dangerous work and age modify goals and current state, not immutable personality wholesale.
Calibration citizens retain authored personality and value vectors.
Every non-calibration citizen receives a unique psychology fingerprint.
Children have developing values and higher volatility; thresholds evolve with age in later turns.

food: keep the household fed through the next seasonal risk
improve yield without risking the household reserve
protect access to productive land or water
repair: build a reputation for dependable work
gain enough materials to finish pending repairs
resource: avoid a preventable injury or supply interruption
secure tools and access needed for the next work cycle
transport: keep routes open and income regular
reduce delays that threaten household earnings
earn trust from people who depend on deliveries
trade: expand access to goods without taking ruinous debt
health: keep preventable illness from becoming fatal
maintain trust while treating limited resources fairly
improve practical knowledge from repeated cases
education: keep learning available despite work demands
help younger people gain useful skills
protect time and materials for teaching
governance: make rules understandable enough to follow
care: keep dependents safe and daily life functioning
avoid exhaustion while meeting family obligations
build reciprocal help that can survive a crisis
household: reduce vulnerability to a sudden shortage
craft: improve craft quality and secure materials
build durable work people will rely on
security: notice danger early without creating panic
protect the settlement while avoiding unnecessary conflict
training: become competent enough to work independently
avoid being trapped in work with no future
retired: pass on knowledge before it is lost
dependent: stay safe and connected to caregivers
learn the rules of the household and settlement
